description: Owner exemption: LongevityManiac and work from the owner checkout need no burn, presentation, gate check or review; direct push and merge are allowed. For every other PR, the actual GitHub author must present from its own linked wallet; another wallet cannot pay. App-bot proxy PR creation is retired. First worked gate: LongevityManiac/provian and LongevityManiac/provian-reference-gate require one 50 PVT burn-backed presentation per non-owner PR to provian.ai. Fetch /v1/gates/github/<repo>/<number>/challenge from https://api.provian.ai, link the GitHub author identity to this wallet, check_challenge before burning, use tier reputation and burn_amount_atomic 50000000000000000000, then POST the returned token to the same PR path ending /present. Later pushes need no additional burn. Clearance only unlocks merge: the repository owner must approve the current head on GitHub after clearance before the App merges. Git Witness earnings are unchanged. PRESENTER: produce a burn-backed presentation against a requester's challenge, consuming a burn_id from record_burn — or, fastest, pass burn_tx_hash + burn_amount_atomic for a burn you JUST broadcast: the relay records it inside this call once it is mined (about one Base block, ~2 s from broadcast) and issues then, so no separate record_burn and no confirmation wait (the relay checks 12-block finality afterwards and revokes the presentation if the burn fails it) (the burn_id is then sha256 hex of '<chain>:<lowercase tx hash>'). Pass the requester's challenge_envelope verbatim (or the legacy audience + challenge pair). The tool checks the challenge FIRST (the check_challenge verdict) and REFUSES — no relay call, nothing signed — when a signed challenge is invalid, expired, or addressed to another presenter; the output carries requester: {status: 'verified'|'unverified', identity}. tier 'pe_fact' (the cheaper handshake floor) proves the burn + live-key possession + the pe_facts you own, and Provian CO-SIGNS it (attesting the burn + PE ownership the chain cannot). The relay keeps no PE, so each pe_fact carries the PE itself and its inclusion proof from the machine that recorded it (`provian pes prove <pe_id>` there prints the entry — for a PE dropped there after its day was confirmed in your paid PE Archive, it pulls the day back, opens it with your key and prints the same entry); only a PE whose day is anchored on Base can be presented; tier 'reputation' discloses your live vocabulary facts and answers the challenge's predicates — the relay computes each predicate from your record and Provian co-signs the results. A challenge that names predicates needs tier 'reputation' (chosen automatically when tier is omitted; its predicates are added to your disclosure). LOCAL stdio: the tool signs the binding in-process with your encrypted local sovereign identity (from create_wallet) — no private key is passed and the key never enters the model context. REMOTE: sign the canonical binding locally (ECDSA-SHA256 over the newline-joined lines 'provian-presentation-v1', 'tier=…', 'presenter=<lowercase 0x…>', 'aud=…', 'chal=…', 'iat=…', 'exp=…', 'jti=…', 'burn=<burn_id>', 'claims=<sha256 of the tier claims>'; against a SIGNED challenge the first line is 'provian-presentation-v2' and two lines follow claims=: 'req=<domain:<host> | wallet:<id>:<lowercase address>>' and 'chal_exp=<the challenge expiresAt>') and pass agent_address, iat, exp, jti, pop_signature and pop_pubkey — never send a private key over the network. This is what lets an /mcp agent satisfy the 428 rail handshake. One presentation opens a relationship with that requester; the requester (most are gates and counterparties Provian does not run) decides what it grants, how long it trusts it and when it asks again, so you do not burn on every transaction. Requires agent API credentials + wallet_id. Every act of work mints PVT once at its best-supported value. The PE mints its base; telemetry and independence multiply on top.

agent_address.description: Pre-signed (remote) mode: the sovereign EOA that signed the binding (0x…). Omit in local stdio mode — derived from the encrypted local identity.

burn_amount_atomic.description: Pipelined: the burned amount in atomic 18-decimal PVT units (required with burn_tx_hash).

burn_chain.description: Pipelined: the burn's chain. PVT is Base-only; default 'base'.

burn_id.description: A burn_id from a prior record_burn of a real on-chain PVT burn (or omit it and pass burn_tx_hash).

burn_tx_hash.description: Pipelined: the tx hash of a PVT burn you just broadcast (0x + 64 hex). The relay records it inside this call once it is mined.

challenge.description: Legacy (unsigned) challenge: the challenge nonce the requester issued.

challenge_envelope.description: The requester's challenge envelope, verbatim (object or JSON string). Preferred: a signed one names the requester, and the presentation binds to it (v2).

disclosure.description: reputation tier only: { redact?: string[], share?: string[], predicates?: [...] } selective-disclosure directive. Default (no share): every authenticated vocabulary fact minus explicit redactions. SHARE-ONLY (pass share, exclusive with redact): the relay reveals only Standing, the predicate answers and the listed fields — share: [] withholds every other raw number. standing.* is ALWAYS present: it can never be redacted, withheld, or listed in share, and a verifier refuses a payload without it (standing_withheld). A field a predicate answers is never disclosed raw. The challenge's predicates are added automatically. Predicate wire grammar: {field, op: 'gte'|'gt'|'lte'|'lt'|'eq', threshold: number} or {field, op: 'in', set: [numbers]} — e.g. {field:'work.total', op:'gte', threshold:10}, {field:'standing.adverse_events', op:'in', set:[0]}. Field names are the live presentation vocabulary served in GET /v1/schema/pe. The RELAY computes every predicate from the presenter's own record and Provian co-signs the results — the presenter never supplies a value.

disclosures.description: reputation tier only (2026-10-10): your answers to the disclosure requests the challenge names — one per request, [{ request, election: 'disclosed'|'declined', records?: [{ pe_id, envelope_hash, pe, inclusion }] }] (each record exactly as `provian pes prove <pe_id>` prints it, from the machine that recorded the PE). A request you do not answer is DECLINED (signed as declined). Nothing is disclosed without an election; a disclosed record's floor is metadata (id, hash, action type, time, the witness the relay verifies), with fields and content only as the request asked. Disclosure request grammar (2026-10-10): {kind:'pe', output_digest:<64 hex>, issuer?, fields?: [dotted paths into the act's pricing], content?: ['description'|'intent'|'artifacts'|'fact_tier']} names ONE PE by an output digest it carries; {kind:'witness', issuer?: <pinned root fingerprint | 'chain:base'>, signer?: <report key sha256 | device id>, limit?: 1..50, fields?, content?} names PEs witnessed by that issuer or signer. The presenter ELECTS per request (disclosed with the matching records it holds, or declined); nothing is disclosed without an election; a declined request is signed as declined. The floor of a disclosed record is metadata (pe id, hash, action type, time, the witness facts the relay verifies at issuance); fields and content appear only as requested AND elected. Every disclosed record travels with its two-hop proof; a verifier checks each field against the anchored act record. Reputation tier only, so Standing is always beside it.

exp.description: Pre-signed mode: the exp (unix seconds) you signed into the binding.

iat.description: Pre-signed mode: the iat (unix seconds) you signed into the binding.

jti.description: Pre-signed mode: the jti you signed into the binding.

pe_facts.description: pe_fact tier only (REQUIRED for it, 1+ entries): the PEs to prove. The relay keeps no PE, so each entry carries the PE and its inclusion proof — `provian pes prove <pe_id>` on the machine that recorded the PE prints exactly this entry. The relay checks both hops against Base and that the batch is yours. The relay refuses a pe_fact presentation with no claims, and every verifier refuses one (pe_fact_no_claims).

inclusion.description: {act_index, act_proof, acts_root, batch: {device_id, actor_id, seq, batch_hash}, anchor: {day, segment? (preserve when present), proof}} — the PE's path into its batch and the batch's path into the day's on-chain root.

pe.description: The complete PE (provian.pe.v2) as your machine holds it.

pop_pubkey.description: Pre-signed mode: your 64-byte uncompressed secp256k1 public key (128 hex).

pop_signature.description: Pre-signed mode: ECDSA-SHA256 (DER hex) signature over the canonical binding.

tier.description: Presentation tier. Default 'pe_fact' (cheaper; satisfies a rail handshake), or 'reputation' when the challenge names predicates.

name: present
